_about: Post ideas. Each idea fits one layout and has several hooks; slots in {curly brackets} are filled from the day's topic or event. Only features LiftRuna really has (checked against the app, 24 Nov 2026). 'needs': topic or event means the idea is only used when one is available. Connor reviews this bank.
